_comment: sourceSentences(sourceText) with no section path -> every sentence of the source as [normalised, eligible, leadIn]: the splitter, the list-marker rule, normaliseDoseText; not eligible when empty, when matching OVERDOSE_SENTENCE_PATTERNS (or the section patterns) or an immediate neighbour of such a sentence, when a list item whose lead-in matches, or when holding a square bracket with a digit. leadIn is the index of the lead-in line (ending in a colon) a list item is bound to, else null. A section path on the overdose list makes none eligible.
